calculationRules.rule: Preserve and do not blindly copy monograph10.1.1 printed %water=(EP1-C30)*C01*C02*C03/C00: EP1 is mL, C30 is labelled mgH2O/2g, C01 is mgH2O/mL, C00 is g, C02 is100 and C03 is25 for2g sample plus50g solvent; the source footnote acknowledges approximation. Subtracting mg from mL is undefined without an identical actual aliquot/endpoint-equivalent blank basis. Independently use T[mg/mL]=m_std[g]*w_cert[mg/g]/(V_std-B_std)[mL]; W_sample[mg]=T*(V_sample-B_sample)-D_once[mg]; water_percent=0.1*W_sample[mg]/m_sample[g]. D_once is only independently measured drift not already corrected in the blank/instrument; do not subtract it twice. If both numerator and denominator are mg, percent uses100 instead. A genuinely homogeneous complete dilution has original sample fraction f=m0/(m0+M_solvent) and sample mass in aliquot f*m_aliquot; subtract actual solvent water represented by that aliquot. Thus2g+50g gives52g and factor26, not25, under those specific assumptions. With settling, W_original=W_actual_liquid+W_retained_residue-W_added_solvent_or_handling; W_actual_liquid=(W_aliquot/m_aliquot)*M_actual_liquid. Do not replace actual liquid mass by total preparation mass or assume retained water zero. These dimensional bridges are transparent technical synthesis, not source errata, a factory measurement or a recipe.
calculationRules.output: water-selective nested mass with full represented-sample bridge

calculationRules.rule: For each actual article and each manufacture, later-service and combined gate, use the whole-wet equation O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + Sgross + EO + Wwhole + J_out + H2O_out. O/C contain all actual empty, attached raw/WIP/non-WIP/FG and reusable stocks. P is independent new external procurement; I is actual packing received contained in a whole supply or in a paired internal handoff, excluding P/ER; ER is external return received, Sgross is full article mass leaving with gross product dispatch or paired internal handoff, EO is a separate outward return to its owner, and Wwhole is the actual discarded whole wet article. J_in/out are real non-water material added/removed; H2O_in/out are real independent water uptake/loss, including natural humidity without repair. None is a fitted residual. Terms are nonoverlapping: water/material already inside O/P/I/ER/C/Sgross/EO/Wwhole stays nested there, never added again as J/H2O. Full contaminated Wwhole includes substrate, retained cleaner, gel residue and water once; do not create separately exported retained contents. Paired internal I/Sgross cancel only at the combined gate. For an expanded diagnostic equation, add OTHER_in - X_in to the left and OTHER_out - X_out to the right of the same equation. X only removes an explicitly identified OTHER same-side representation already contained in that side's gross flow; 0 <= X <= the proven duplicate OTHER. X cannot subtract O/C, any real J/H2O increment, an opposite-side leg or a merely present card. Actual repair/refill materials and outward removed matter need their exact atomic cards if present; the symbols do not assert that repair or moisture occurs. Keep physical amounts, provider burden ownership and service allocations distinct; no new Q, coproduct or avoided product from return/reuse.
calculationRules.output: independent whole wet physical pool

calculationRules.rule: For each actually separate waste event t, retain receiver identity, Qt equal to the full as-transferred wet physical load, complete nested substrate/retained gel/cleaner/water composition, collection/storage changes and actual complete treatment-provider interface. Separate liquid/cloth/gel/packing rows apply only to material not already inside a mixed whole event. Determine the provider's full physical demand Ut = convert_actual(Qt, actual provider reference unit) using measured compatible mass/volume/state or actual batch interface, never an invented kg-to-item factor. Either use a genuine full treatment producer once or expand its real treatment, transport, utilities, residuals and emissions; include actual on-site pretreatment separately without repurchasing embedded work. Attribution is a different account: for every exchange e retain the full treatment vector Bt,e and original-cohort A_t,c,e plus other actual beneficiaries/unassigned portions; the portions are disjoint and sum to Bt,e. Use actual justified service drivers and original Q0,c for each A_t,c,e/Q0,c. Qt and Ut do not become the allocated share, and the full provider must not be charged again to each cohort. Prior treatment/service history and subsequent increments are distinguished once. Unknown assignment or provider unit bridge stays unresolved with full raw loads, not a smaller physical export or a zero treatment demand.
calculationRules.output: full Qt/Ut and disjoint original-cohort A/Q0

calculationRules.rule: 保留而不盲抄10.1.1印刷式 %water=(EP1-C30)*C01*C02*C03/C00：EP1为mL、C30标mgH2O/2g、C01为mgH2O/mL、C00为g、C02为100，2g样加50g溶剂C03标25；原脚注承认近似。不经相同实际分样/终点等效空白基准转换，mL减mg无量纲意义。独立采用 T[mg/mL]=m_std[g]*w_cert[mg/g]/(V_std-B_std)[mL]；W_sample[mg]=T*(V_sample-B_sample)-D_once[mg]；water_percent=0.1*W_sample[mg]/m_sample[g]。D_once仅为独立实测且未被空白/仪器已校正的漂移，不扣两遍。分子分母同为mg时百分数才乘100。真正均相全溶稀释的原样份额 f=m0/(m0+M_solvent)，分样所含原样质量为f*m_aliquot，并扣除该分样真实代表的溶剂水；故在这些特定假设下2g+50g为52g、因子26而非25。沉降时 W_original=W_actual_liquid+W_retained_residue-W_added_solvent_or_handling；W_actual_liquid=(W_aliquot/m_aliquot)*M_actual_liquid。不得以全制样质量替实际液相质量或假定滞留水为零。此量纲桥是透明技术综合，不是来源勘误、工厂实测或配方。
calculationRules.output: water-selective nested mass with full represented-sample bridge

calculationRules.rule: 每种实际物品分别对制造、后续服务及合并边界使用全湿等式 O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + Sgross + EO + Wwhole + J_out + H2O_out。O/C含实际空置、附着原料/在制品/未加工非在制品/成品及可复用的全部库存。P是独立新增外购；I是整份供货内含或成对内部交接实际收到的包装，不含P/ER；ER为收到的外部退回，Sgross为随产品毛发运或成对内部交接外出的完整物品，EO为单独向所有者退还的出口，Wwhole为实际丢弃的整湿物品。J_in/out为真实非水物料增减；H2O_in/out为真实独立水分吸收/损失，包括没有修理的自然湿气变化；均不得拟合残差。各项互斥：O/P/I/ER/C/Sgross/EO/Wwhole中已含的水和物料只作嵌套，不能再加为J/H2O。Wwhole含基材、残留清洁剂、凝胶残留和水一次，不能虚构另行外排的内含物。成对内部I/Sgross仅在合并边界抵消。扩展诊断等式在同一等式左侧加 OTHER_in - X_in，右侧加 OTHER_out - X_out。X仅可移除该侧毛流内已包含、已明确识别的OTHER同侧重复表示；0 <= X <= 有证据的重复OTHER。X不能扣O/C、任何真实J/H2O增量、反向腿或仅有卡片。实际修理/补充物料及真实移出物若存在，需其具体原子卡；符号并不宣称有修理或吸湿。实物流、供方负荷所有权和服务分配分账，退还/复用不产生新Q、共产品或避免产品。
calculationRules.output: independent whole wet physical pool

calculationRules.rule: 每个真实分离废物事件t保留接收者、Qt为按交付状态的完整湿实物量、完整嵌套基材/残留凝胶/清洁剂/水组成、收集/保管库存变化及真实完整处理供方接口。分离液体/布/凝胶/包装卡仅用于不在混合整物事件内的物质。供方完整实物需求 Ut = convert_actual(Qt, 真实供方参考单位)，以实测兼容质量/体积/状态或实际批次接口转换，不能编千克到件的系数。真实完整处理生产者仅链接一次，或展开真实处理、运输、公用、残余及排放；现场实际预处理单列，不重买已内含工作。归属是另一本账：每交换e保留完整处理向量Bt,e和原批A_t,c,e及其他实际受益/未归属份额；份额互斥且合计Bt,e。采用真实合理服务驱动，分别按各原Q0,c报告A_t,c,e/Q0,c。Qt、Ut不变成分配份额，也不能向每个批次各计整份供方。原处理/服务历史与后续增量分别一次。归属未知或供方单位桥未知须保留全量原账和未解决结果，不能缩实物出口或记零处理。
calculationRules.output: full Qt/Ut and disjoint original-cohort A/Q0
